entries.title: Luke 15:1
segments: Now all the tax-gatherers and sinners continued to draw near him, and to listen to him.

entries.title: Luke 15:2
segments: And the Pharisees and Scribes began to complain, saying, "He is welcoming sinners and eating with them!"

entries.title: Luke 15:3
segments: And he told them a parable:

entries.title: Luke 15:4
segments: "Which one of you men, if he has a hundred sheep, and has lost one of them, does not leave the ninety and nine in the desert and go after the lost one until he finds it?

entries.title: Luke 15:5
segments: "And after he has found it, he lays it on his shoulder, rejoicing.

entries.title: Luke 15:6
segments: "When he gets home he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying, "Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep that was lost.'

entries.title: Luke 15:7
segments: "I say to you that even so there shall be joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, more than over ninety and nine just persons who need no repentance.

entries.title: Luke 15:8
segments: "Or, again, suppose a woman has ten coins. If she loses one, does she not light a lamp and sweep the house, and search anxiously until she finds it?

entries.title: Luke 15:9
segments: "And when she has found it, she calls together her woman friends and neighbors and say, `Rejoice with me, for I have found the coin which I had lost.'

entries.title: Luke 15:10
segments: "Even so I tell you there is joy in the presence of the angels for God over one sinner who repents."

entries.title: Luke 15:11
segments: And he said: "There was a man who had two sons.

entries.title: Luke 15:12
segments: "The younger of them said to his father, `Father, give me the share of your property which is coming to me.' So he divided his means among them.

entries.title: Luke 15:13
segments: "Not many days after that the younger son gathered everything together and took his journey into a distant country; and there he wasted his money on living unsavingly.

entries.title: Luke 15:14
segments: "After he had spent everything there came a terrible famine in the land, and he began to be in want.

entries.title: Luke 15:15
segments: "So he went and hired to one of the citizens of that land, who sent him out into the fields to feed swine.

entries.title: Luke 15:16
segments: "And he was longing to be filled with the husks which the swine were eating, but no one gave him any.

entries.title: Luke 15:17
segments: "When he came to himself he said: "`How many of my father's hired men have bread enough and to spare, while I am perishing of hunger!

entries.title: Luke 15:18
segments: "`I will rise and go to my father, and say to him: "Father, I have sinned against Heaven and in your sight,

entries.title: Luke 15:19
segments: "`"I am no more worthy to be called your son; only make me like one of your hired men."'

entries.title: Luke 15:20
segments: "So he arose and went to his father; but while he was yet a great way off, his father saw him and was moved with compassion, and ran and fell on his neck and kissed him.

entries.title: Luke 15:21
segments: "The son said to him, `Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight and am no more worthy to be called your son.'

entries.title: Luke 15:22
segments: "`Fetch the best robe, quick,' said the father to his slaves, `and put it on him, and give him a ring on his finger, and shoes on his feet.

entries.title: Luke 15:23
segments: "`Bring that fatted calf and kill it, and let us eat and make merry,

entries.title: Luke 15:24
segments: "`for this son of mine was dead and is alive again--he was lost and is found.'

entries.title: Luke 15:25
segments: "So they began to make merry. But his elder son was in the field, and as he drew near to the house he heard music and dancing,

entries.title: Luke 15:26
segments: "and he summoned one of the slaves, and began to inquire of him what all this meant.

entries.title: Luke 15:27
segments: "`Your brother is come,' he replied, `and your father has killed the fatted calf, because he has him safe and sound.'

entries.title: Luke 15:28
segments: "But he was angry and would not go in; so his father came out, and attempted to plead with him; but he said to his father:

entries.title: Luke 15:29
segments: "`All these years I have been slaving for you and never disobeyed a command of yours. Yet you never gave me even a kid so that I might make merry with my friends.

entries.title: Luke 15:30
segments: "`But when this son of yours came, who has devoured your property with harlots, you have killed him the fatted calf.'

entries.title: Luke 15:31
segments: "`My dear son,' answered his father, `you are always with me and all that is mine is yours.

entries.title: Luke 15:32
segments: "`But it was fitting that we should make merry and rejoice, for this brother of yours was dead and is alive; he was lost and is found.'"
